adjudicators.reasoning: Strided sections are allowed in from clauses. But the corresponding arrays may share storage with the originals, and the guarantee of sharing is not claimed for the target data case; if they share, the device writes reach the host without any update and the observed all-elements-changed output is permitted. Reading B's claim that the whole-array result is non-conforming ignores the sharing allowance. Reading A holds.

C array section a[0:4:2] with stride is allowed in target update from; the list item is treated as replaced by its elements, so only those elements are assigned. a,b,c are present from target data, so the target region copies nothing back. With separate memory (as recorded) other elements must keep host values; whole-array copy-back is a defect. The shared-storage argument does not fit a run recorded as separate memory.
